evidence.detail: Look for companions in sideboard and not main deck in archetype rules — adds COMPANIONS set and sideboard=TRUE flag for companion cards in rules
Merged PR that implements this fix, description matches the issue exactly
COMPANIONS = search.search('is:companion') is set at module level
sideboard = 'TRUE' if c in COMPANIONS else 'FALSE' marks companion rule cards as sideboard=TRUE so apply_rules_query matches them in deck sideboards

triage.notes: The fix was merged 2024-07-30. Issue can be closed.
triage.proposed_comment: This was fixed in commit 471b7632 (PR #12940). Companion cards added to archetype rules are now automatically flagged as sideboard cards, so the rules engine correctly looks for them in deck sideboards rather than the maindeck.
